calibration_anchor.closest_anchor: Product Hunt launch at unknown startup
calibration_anchor.why_not_higher: A Product Hunt ranking is a community-vote metric, not a journalist hook. No data, customer proof, or business traction provided.
calibration_anchor.why_not_lower: The product claim itself (AI fundraising agent) has some category interest, but it is pure marketing

beat_relevance.rationale: Startups beat exists but product is undifferentiated AI tooling

timeliness.rationale: No news hook beyond product launch; no external moment or embargo

magnitude.rationale: Unknown seed-stage startup with no disclosed traction or market scale

proof_points.rationale: Product Hunt upvotes are community vanity metrics, not proof

narrative_quality.rationale: Framing is generic 'AI agent finds investors'

source_credibility.rationale: Unknown founder with no stated expertise or track record

improvement_suggestions: Do not lead with Product Hunt ranking; it is not news
Bring customer usage data, founder background, or a concrete business milestone
Tie to a macro trend in founder tooling if evidence exists
evidence_gaps: Actual user traction, revenue, or customer names
Data on whether investors are actually using the tool
honest_assessment: A Product Hunt ranking is a vanity metric, not a news hook. This is a launch announcement with no proof of business traction. Journalists do not cover products because they ranked on PH.

next_move.rationale: Hold until there is actual business proof
